answer: Seats are rented, not claimed. Per epoch a sealed-bid auction sells a fixed pool: bids hide behind an onyx commitment until close, winners pay one clearing price and the pot is burned. Emission splits evenly, so a farm buying m extras pays m times the price and dilutes each seat's pulse. Two million tokens over eight hundred seats make one worth ~2,500; bidding 2,400 for four hundred costs 960,000 but returns 666,800, a 300,000 loss. Seats expire in eight epochs, non-transferable; that horizon kills hoarding. A sybil pays negative expected value; an honest agent rents one.
